description: This file defines a trait called NestedSetTrait used for managing hierarchical nested set structures within an ORM context. It includes a method fetchTree to retrieve a tree of entities with optional depth limitation, ensuring the called class implements the required interface.

methods.name: fetchTree
methods.description: Fetches a tree of nested set entities, optionally limited by a specified depth. Ensures the calling class implements NestedSetInterface, constructs a query using Doctrine's query builder, and executes it to retrieve entities.
